slots.notes: Fullscreen hero backdrop set via inline style={{ backgroundImage: url(...) }} on the section, rendered bg-cover bg-center over a min-h-[100svh] container, so it crops to any viewport. Native asset is an atmospheric sky/landscape photo whose lower edge meets the grass overlay; the dark-text navbar, headline (text-gray-900) and muted body (text-gray-600) all sit directly on it, so the upper third must stay light enough for near-black UI to read. Delivered as a remote raster (higgs.ai webp proxy placeholder); this is the socket for a brand's hero photograph/render.

Decorative foreground strip pinned to the bottom of the section (absolute bottom-0 left-0 z-10 w-full, pointer-events-none select-none), full width, sitting in front of the dashboard mockup which is pulled up under it via negative margin. Native asset is a horizontal grass PNG; must be a transparent (alpha) cutout that bleeds off both side edges and reads as a grounding band. Cloudinary placeholder URL; the socket for a brand's foreground/horizon element (skyline, waves, fog, etc.).

Custom logo glyph reused twice: in the navbar (text-gray-900, w-5 h-5 sm:w-6 sm:h-6) and inside the dashboard mockup sidebar (w-4 h-4 text-white/70). Authored as an inline SVG component, viewBox 0 0 256 256, fill=currentColor so it inherits text color (dark on the hero, white in the dark mockup). Native art is a hardcoded angular monogram path; swapping the mark means replacing the path data, not a URL.
Small disclosure caret next to the 'Toolkit' desktop nav item (native: lucide-react ChevronDown, w-3.5 h-3.5, text-gray-700 inheriting). Hidden below md with the rest of the desktop nav.
Open/close glyph pair for the md:hidden hamburger button (w-9 h-9 rounded-full, text-gray-900), toggling between the two states (native: lucide-react Menu and X, w-5 h-5).

Glyph inside the dark circular submit button of the hero search pill (w-9 h-9 sm:w-10 sm:h-10 rounded-full bg-gray-900, hover:scale-105 active:scale-95). Native: lucide-react ArrowUp, w-4 h-4 sm:w-[18px] sm:h-[18px], white on gray-900.

Inline accent glyph embedded mid-sentence in the hero description, immediately before the 'ChatGPT' word (native: lucide-react Sparkles, inline w-4 h-4 -mt-1, inheriting the text-gray-600 description color).

Browser-chrome icon set inside the dark dashboard mockup title bar and URL bar (all small, white/40 or white/25). Native lucide-react glyphs: PanelLeft, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Monitor (in the 'questly.ai' URL pill), plus the right cluster RotateCw, Share, Plus, Copy; carried into the content area as Sparkles (Generate button) and the sidebar nav Compass, Layers, ListTodo, Grid. Decorative dashboard dressing; themeable via currentColor.

Square workspace/brand tile shown twice in the dashboard mockup (sidebar w-4 h-4 rounded badge and main-header w-9 h-9 rounded-lg), native rendered as a solid #e8553f swatch bearing a 'C' initial for the fictional 'CareNest' workspace. Socket for a brand avatar/monogram tile; if left as a tinted initial it samples the accent role.

mechanic: A single static min-h-[100svh] flex column (fade-down navbar / center-stacked headline + search pill + description + CTAs / a ScaledDashboard browser-mockup) over a fixed background photo with a bottom grass overlay, where every block enters once on load via staggered blur-up fade-up keyframes and the dashboard rises and overlaps the grass with a negative bottom margin.
techDelivery: React + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS 3 with lucide-react icons; the 'Nimbus Sans TW01' webfont is linked via an onlinewebfonts stylesheet in index.html and registered in tailwind.config.js + index.css; keyframes (fade-up / fade-down / hero-rise) live in index.css and motion is pure CSS animation (no animation library); the dashboard uses a ResizeObserver-based ScaledDashboard wrapper that renders at a fixed 896px design width and CSS transform:scale()s down to fit.
reskinNotes: Color is not centralized: the light hero palette is expressed as hardcoded Tailwind gray utilities (text-gray-900 / text-gray-700 / text-gray-600, bg-gray-900 CTAs, ring-gray-200/300) while the dashboard mockup is an entirely separate dark theme built from inline hex literals (bg-[#1a1a1c], bg-[#242427], bg-[#1e1e21], #e8553f workspace, traffic-light #ff5f57/#febc2e/#28c840, status #28c840/#febc2e) and white/N alpha values rather than CSS variables, so the colorRoles block samples both worlds (fg/fgMuted from the gray hero text, bg/surface/border from the dark mockup, accent #e8553f and accent2 #28c840 from the mockup) and a true retint means editing utility class strings and inline hex in both the hero and DashboardMockup. The logo is a hardcoded inline SVG path (no asset URL). All copy is hardcoded in JSX, including a literal double-newline line break inside the headline ('Get cited.' / 'Effortlessly.') and a mid-sentence break in the description, plus the entire fictional 'questly.ai' / 'CareNest' dashboard dataset (stat numbers, subject cards, drafting-inbox question rows). Headline sizing is a long responsive arbitrary-value ramp (text-[40px] -> [80px]) tuned to the native condensed face, so a wider replacement display font reflows the two lines. The ScaledDashboard relies on a fixed 896px design width measured by ResizeObserver; the mockup's internal layout is not fluid and only scales as a whole. Staggered entrance timing is encoded as inline [animation-delay:Xms] arbitrary values on each element.
